blocks.title: Energy
blocks.text: Jism ki energy us ki kaam karne ki salahiyat hai. Energy ki do bunyadi shakalein hain: (i) kinetic energy aur (ii) potential energy. Kinetic energy woh energy hai jo jism apni harkat ki wajah se rakhta hai, aur potential energy woh jo jism apni badli hui jagah ki wajah se rakhta hai. Dono mechanical energy ki qismein hain.

Chalte jism ki kinetic energy ka formula akhz karein. Sarak par mustaqil speed se chalti car lein: agar us ka engine band kar diya jaye to woh rukne se pehle kuch faasla phir bhi tay karti hai. Jab tak woh chalti hai sarak ki raghrat ki force ke khilaf kaam karti hai; is wuqfe mein woh raghrat ki force f ke barabar miqdar ki force lagati hai. Agar rukne se pehle tay kiya faasla d ho to car ka kiya kaam f d hai. Yeh kaam car apni harkat ki wajah se karti hai; jism ki apni harkat ki wajah se kaam karne ki salahiyat us ki kinetic energy hai, to car ki kinetic energy f d ke barabar hai. Acceleration Newton ke doosre qanoon F = ma se milta hai; jaise car sust ho kar aakhir rukti hai, us ka acceleration a manfi hai kyunke yeh harkat ki simt ke ulat lagne wali raghrat ki force f se paida hota hai: f = -ma, ya a = -f/m. f d ki qeemat teesri equation of motion 2aS = vf^2 - vi^2 se milti hai, ibtidai velocity vi = v, aakhri velocity vf = 0, faasla S = d aur acceleration a = -f/m ke saath: 2 (-f/m) d = 0 - v^2, to f d = (1/2) m v^2. Chunke f d jism ki kinetic energy ke barabar hai, kinetic energy = (1/2) m v^2 ... (4.9). Chunke kinetic energy us kaam ke barabar hai jo jism kar sakta hai, us ka unit kaam wala hona chahiye, joule (J).

blocks.title: Example 4.3
blocks.text: 18620 N wazan ki car 16 m s^-1 se chalti hai; brake lagte hain aur woh 80 m mein ruk jati hai. Us par lagne wali raghrat ki ausat force nikalein. Hal: v = 16 m s^-1, d = 80 m, w = 18620 N, f = ?. Car ki kinetic energy rukne se pehle us ke kiye kaam ke barabar hai: (1/2) m v^2 = f d. Yahan m = w/g = 18620 N / 9.8 m s^-2 = 1900 kg. Qeematein rakhte hue (1/2) x 1900 kg x (16 m s^-1)^2 = f x 80 m, ya f = 3040 N.

blocks.text: Potential energy jism ke paas force field mein us ki jagah ki wajah se hoti hai, maslan gravitational field, ya us ki majboor halat (constrained state) ki wajah se. Dabi hui spring mein mehfooz energy woh potential energy hai jo spring apni dabi ya khinchi halat ki wajah se rakhti hai; is shakal ko elastic potential energy kehte hain.

blocks.title: Mutlaq gravitational potential energy
blocks.text: Kisi jagah par cheez ki mutlaq gravitational potential energy woh kaam hai jo gravitational force cheez ko us jagah se la-mahdood (infinity) tak hilane mein karti hai, jahan gravity ki force sifr ho jati hai.

Gravitational force ke kaam ya potential energy ka taalluq mgh sirf Zameen ki satah ke qareeb durust hai, jahan gravitational force taqreeban mustaqil hai. Agar jism khala mein bare faasle tak hilaya jaye, maan lein nuqte 1 se N tak (Fig. 4.11), to gravitational force mustaqil nahi rehti, kyunke yeh faasle ke muraba ke ulat badalti hai. Is mushkil par qaboo pane ko hum nuqton 1 aur N ke darmiyan faasle ko lambai delta r ke chhote qadmon mein bantte hain, taake har qadam mein force amalan mustaqil rahe; kul kaam phir sab qadmon mein kiye kaam ka majmooa hai. Agar r1 aur r2 nuqton 1 aur 2 ke Zameen ke markaz O se faasle hon to pehle qadam, nuqte 1 se nuqte 2 tak, ka kaam yun milta hai. Is qadam ke markaz aur Zameen ke markaz ka faasla r = (r1 + r2)/2 hai; chunke r2 - r1 = delta r, r2 = r1 + delta r, is liye r = (r1 + r1 + delta r)/2 = r1 + delta r / 2 ... (4.10). Is qadam ke markaz par gravitational force F = G M m / r^2 ... (4.11), jahan m cheez ka mass, M Zameen ka mass aur G gravitational constant hai. Eq. 4.10 ko muraba karne par r^2 = (r1 + delta r / 2)^2 = r1^2 + 2 r1 delta r / 2 + (delta r / 2)^2; chunke (delta r)^2 r1^2 se bohat chhota hai use nazar andaz kiya ja sakta hai, is liye r^2 = r1^2 + r1 delta r; delta r = r2 - r1 rakhne par r^2 = r1^2 + r1 (r2 - r1) = r1 r2. Is liye Eq. 4.11 ban jati hai F = G M m / (r1 r2) ... (4.12).

blocks.alt: Zameen, markaz O. O se amoodi lakeer par nuqte 1, 2, 3, 4 aur phir nuqtedar (dotted) faasle ke baad N. Nuqte 1, 2 aur O se ufqi lakeerein; 1 aur 2 ke darmiyan chhota faasla delta r hai. Dashed dohre teer O se nuqte 1 tak r1 aur nuqte 2 tak r2 dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.11: Zameen ke oopar nuqte 1 se N, qadam delta r aur markaz O se faasle r1 aur r2 (kitab ki Figure 4.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Door jane par gravity ki force badalti hai, is liye rasta chhote qadmon delta r mein kata gaya hai. Har qadam mein force taqreeban mustaqil hai. r1 aur r2 Zameen ke markaz O se napte hain, satah se nahi; N bohat door (infinity) hai.

Chunke yeh force wuqfe delta r mein mustaqil mani gayi hai, kiya kaam W(1 se 2) = F . delta r = F delta r cos 180 = -G M m delta r / (r1 r2) hai; manfi nishan batata hai ke nuqte 1 se 2 tak jism par kaam karna parta hai, kyunke displacement gravitational force ke ulat hai. delta r = r2 - r1 rakhne par W(1 se 2) = -G M m (r2 - r1)/(r1 r2) = -G M m (1/r1 - 1/r2). Isi tarah doosre qadam, nuqte 2 se 3 tak, ka kaam W(2 se 3) = -G M m (1/r2 - 1/r3), aur aakhri qadam mein W(N-1 se N) = -G M m (1/r(N-1) - 1/rN). Is liye jism ko nuqte 1 se N tak hilane ka kul kaam W_total = W(1 se 2) + W(2 se 3) + ... + W(N-1 se N) = -G M m [(1/r1 - 1/r2) + (1/r2 - 1/r3) + ... + (1/r(N-1) - 1/rN)], jo saada ho kar W_total = -G M m (1/r1 - 1/rN) banta hai. Agar nuqta N Zameen se la-mahdood faasle par ho to rN = infinity, to 1/rN = 1/infinity = 0; is liye W_total = -G M m / r1. Yeh kul kaam tareef ke mutabiq mutlaq potential energy hai, jo U se zahir hoti hai: U = -G M m / r, Zameen ke markaz se faasle r par jism ki gravitational potential energy ki mutlaq qeemat. Jab r barhta hai U kam manfi hoti hai, yani U barhti hai: jab hum jism ko Zameen ki satah se oopar uthate hain to us ki potential energy barhti hai, to jism ko la-mahdood faasle tak uthane ke liye us par G M m / R ke barabar kaam karna hoga, jis ke baad us ki potential energy sifr ho jati hai. Zameen ki satah par mutlaq potential energy r = R, Zameen ka radius, rakh kar milti hai: mutlaq potential energy = U_g = -G M m / R ... (4.13). Manfi nishan dikhata hai ke mass m ke liye Zameen ki gravitational field kashish wali hai; yeh expression woh kaam ya energy deta hai jo jism ko Zameen ki gravitational field se bahar le jane ko chahiye, jahan Zameen ki nisbat us ki potential energy sifr hai.

blocks.prompt: Cycle ki kinetic energy 150 J hai. Usi mass par dugni speed se, aur teen guna mass par aadhi speed se us ki KE kya hogi (short question 4.9)? Agar Zameen ka mass 6.0 x 10^24 kg aur Suraj ka 1.99 x 10^30 kg ho, 160 million km door, to Zameen ki gravitational PE nikalein (numerical 4.3).
blocks.explanation: KE, m v^2 ke mutanasib hai: dugni speed chaar guna deti hai, 600 J; teen guna mass aadhi speed par 3 x (1/4) = 3/4 deta hai, to 112.5 J. U = -G M m / r = -(6.67 x 10^-11)(1.99 x 10^30)(6.0 x 10^24) / (1.6 x 10^11) = -4.98 x 10^33 J, chhape -4.97 x 10^33 J ke qareeb.

items: Energy = kaam karne ki salahiyat; kinetic (harkat) aur potential (jagah), dono mechanical. KE: raghrat ke khilaf rukti car f d = (1/2) m v^2 karti hai, to KE = (1/2) m v^2 (joule). Example 4.3: f = 3040 N.

PE: field mein jagah ya majboor halat (spring ki elastic PE). Mutlaq PE = jagah se la-mahdood tak gravity ka kaam: qadam delta r, F = GMm/(r1 r2), W(1 se 2) = -GMm (1/r1 - 1/r2), majmooa U = -GMm/r; satah par U_g = -GMm/R (4.13), manfi kyunke field kashish wali hai; mgh sirf satah ke qareeb.
